question: In Canada, can a minority government stay in office, and what happens if it loses a confidence vote?
generated_answer: In Canada, a minority government can stay in office if it can maintain the confidence of the House of Commons. You can read more about this in the House of Commons website. If a minority government loses a confidence vote, it is expected to resign and allow the Governor General to invite another party or coalition to form a government. This is known as a "vote of no confidence." You can read more about this in the House of Commons website.
